user.title: Connect an E.ON browser session
user.description: Log in at eon.pl/mojeon, then copy the Cookie request header from a successful GetPHList request in browser developer tools. This session secret is stored locally in Home Assistant. Automatic password login is not supported.

select.title: Choose prosumer supply points
select.description: History is downloaded daily from this fixed start date. Confirmed data only by default. Enable estimates to include uncertain and forecast values; missing values are excluded.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew the E.ON session
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again in your browser and paste a fresh Cookie header for the same account.

error.invalid_auth: The browser session is invalid or expired.
error.wrong_account: This session cannot access all configured supply points.
error.invalid_selection: Choose accessible supply points and a start date from 2022 to two days ago.

abort.no_oze_accounts: No active prosumer supply points were found. Standard electricity accounts are not supported by this report endpoint.
abort.already_configured: One or more supply points are already configured.
